h: Fear of Heaven Gives Torah Its True Worth

p: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְגוֹ׳ (מִשְׁלֵי לא, כט)
According to what we said (above, maamar 6),
(as Rashi explains at the end of Berachos):
so is my beloved among the daughters";
וְכֵן רָאוּהָ בָנוֹת וְגוֹ׳ (שָׁם ו, ט)
as the nations of the world;
but here that has no place.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (עֵירוּבִין כא, ב)
based on what they said in the Gemara (Eruvin 21b):
these are the masters of Scripture, etc.;
'there I will give you my love'
I will show you My glory and My greatness,
the praise of My sons and My daughters."
of the masters of Scripture, Mishnah and Gemara,
and daughters are not people of Torah study.
these are the exiles of Bavel,
whose mind is settled upon them like sons;
'and My daughters from the end of the earth'
these are the exiles of the other lands,
whose mind is not settled upon them, like daughters."
(And there is support for this in Tanchuma, Noach 3:
And the Maharsha, of blessed memory, explained:
that there were the craftsmen and the smiths;
And one may interpret the expression
as referring to Torah she'b'al peh,
with the knowledge of ruach hakodesh
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב רַמְבַּ״ן בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, ב)
(as the Ramban wrote on Bava Basra 12b);
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג סא, א)
And this is what it says:
whose mind is settled upon them," etc.;
for the main spreading of Torah she'b'al peh
"Ezra came up from Bavel and established it, etc.;
Hillel the Babylonian established it, etc."
"'He has set me in dark places' (Eichah 3:6)
this is the Talmud of Bavel."
That is, there was the main spreading
to bring forth light from within the darkness
the light that was created on the first day,
which HaKadosh Baruch Hu hid away
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh";
and that refers to the Babylonian Talmud.
And this is what it says: "I will show you My glory and My greatness"
whose mind is settled upon them like sons;
the students of the exiles of other lands,
whose mind is not settled upon them, like daughters.
And this is what it says: "Many daughters"
the students of the exiles of other lands,
whose mind in Torah she'b'al peh
is not settled upon them, like daughters
אֵשֶׁת חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ (מִשְׁלֵי יב, ד)
"a woman of valor is the crown of her husband" (Mishlei 12:4),
the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah
together with those who toil in Torah,
who are Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג כט, ב)
"Grace is false and beauty is vain":
even those who toil in Torah,
if it is only for grace and for beauty,
without fear of Heaven in them,
לָמָּה זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד כְּסִיל כוּ׳ (מִשְׁלֵי יז, טז)
"'Why is there a price in the hand of a fool,' etc. (Mishlei 17:16)
and have no fear of Heaven in them."
And it is called a price in the hand of a fool,
"Woe to one who has no courtyard
and makes a gate for the courtyard."
And this is what it says:
"Grace is false and beauty is vain;
a woman who fears Hashem, she shall be praised."
